examples.pie: nu toy h₂ŕ̥ǵre h₂mélǵos ǵʰumé. léwke gʷʰermóm h₂mélǵos ph₃dʰí. gʷówes polh₁éwes kéh₂ilōs-kʷe h₁sih₁ént.
examples.en: Now we have poured milk for you, shining one. Drink the warm milk, bright one. May the cows be many and healthy.

examples.pie: nu moy h₂éwsos suHnúm dh₃dʰí. ḱuh₁rós ǵn̥h₃rós ḱlutós-kʷe h₁syéh₁t. h₁ésyo-kʷe ḱléwos méǵh₂ h₁syéh₁t. nu tébʰye sweh₂dú médʰu ǵʰḗm.
examples.en: Now, Dawn, give me a son! May he be strong and wise and famous. And may his fame be great. Now I have poured the sweet mead for you.

examples.pie: nékʷti ne swépm̥. kʷíd bʰéwdʰes? trḗm. príHe mē tréms. ḱwṓ nos stégos kʷsépi h₂lékseti.
examples.en: I did not fall asleep in the night. Why were you awake? I was trembling. Do not tremble, friend! Our dog guards the house at night.

examples.pie: pl̥h₁h₂é. príHe h₁ddʰí. pótnih₂ moy toy ḱód h₂réydʰet. tetórph₂e. nu píph₃e. nu légʰesi.

examples.pie: ph₂ter sh₂wéni sddʰí. gʷʰért. dʰúgh₂ter me sóh₂wl̥ gʷʰr̥néwti. ǵʰiméni sríHǵesi trḗm. nu gʷṓs h₂mélǵsi? tā́s móḱs h₂mélǵmi.
examples.en: Father, sit in the sun! It has grown warm. The sun warms me, daughter. In winter I trembled in the cold. Are you milking the cows now? I milk them early.

examples.pie: kʷíd sríHgos? dʰéǵʰōm nékʷti stéwdt sríHgos-kʷe dʰéyǵʰesh₂ h₂usési stégeti. sríHgos tinéh₁ti? tinéh₁ti h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ léwketi.
examples.en: What is frost? At night the earth becomes cold, and at dawn frost covers the walls. Does the frost melt? It melts when the sun becomes bright.

examples.pie: bʰréh₂ter trémsi. snigʷʰés dedwóyth₂e? tósyeh₂s ne dedwóyh₂e. sríHgos me h₁épt. nu péh₂wr̥ gʷm̥dʰí. gʷm̥sḱóh₂. ph₂tréy-kʷe nos mē wéwkes.
examples.en: You are trembling, brother! Are you afraid of the snow? I am not afraid of it. The cold has seized me. Then come to the fire! I am coming. And do not tell our father!

examples.en: Who crossed the sea? The birds crossed it.

examples.pie: léymonm̥ kʷsépi mē térh₂s.

examples.pie: kʷíd h₂éwh₂e pérwr̥? pérwr̥ sruméns pértus. h₂ékʷeh₂ h₂én ne dʰubʰréh₂. wiHrṓs gʷówes-kʷe h₂én tr̥h₂ént. h₁yód déh₂nu dʰubʰróm kʷíh₁ wiHrṓs tr̥h₂ént? neh₂ubʰís tr̥h₂ént.

examples.pie: wéwke moy kʷóti h₁éḱwons h₂eh₂óyḱth₂e? septḿ̥ h₁éḱwons dwóyh₁-kʷe káprōm déḱm̥tih₁ h₂eh₂óyḱh₂e. kʷós h₁éḱwos HéHḱistos? ḱásnos HéHḱistos. gʷm̥dʰí h₁ím-kʷe dr̥ḱdʰí.
examples.en: Tell me, how many horses do you own? I own seven horses and twenty goats. Which horse is the swiftest? The grey one is the swiftest. Come and look at him!

examples.pie: kúdʰe swésor h₁éḱwons wodʰéyesi? déh₂nu. tr̥syónti. méǵʰye ḱóm gʷémesi? gʷémoh₂. ḱásneh₂i márkoy h₁épi h₃réyHdʰe. h₁íh₂ gʷr̥déwih₂. pró ne h₃réyHdʰom. dedwóyh₂e. mē bʰéyh₂s. h₁ésyeh₂s gʷriHwéh₂m h₁pdʰí bʰérēti-kʷe te.
examples.en: Sister, where are you leading the horses? To the river. They are thirsty. Will you come with me? I will come! Ride on the grey mare. She is slow. I did not ride before. I am afraid. Do not be afraid. Hold her mane, and she will carry you.

examples.pie: méh₂ter nésm̥. súHnew stóygʰom polh₁úns dinóns spéḱyom. kénkesi? kénkoh₂ tr̥syóh₂-kʷe. ḱóm mā́dsom h₁ddʰí wódr̥-kʷe bʰr̥h₁wéns ph₃dʰí. méh₂ter toy ḱérh₂sō ḱásnos bʰúHt. ḱéh₂dos me ǵorh₂éyet. nu h₁eǵóh₂ h₂éti h₂yuHn̥ḱéh₂.
examples.en: Mother, I have come home unharmed! Son, for many days I looked at the road. Are you hungry? I am hungry and thirsty. Eat this mush, and drink water from the spring. Your head has become grey, mother. Grief made me old. Now I am young again!
